node.title: M720 off-laptop complete zero certificates
node.statement: For the h=7..20 calibration cells used by midlarge_h7_20, complete zero-certificate payloads supply cell parameters, complete=true flags, and zero unpaid non-toral active-core counts.
node.attack_surface: assembly from WSL-safe complete-cell certificates and residual off-laptop complete-cell execution
node.falsifier: a complete calibration cell with nonzero unpaid non-toral active cores, or missing/false completeness metadata
